_notes: What the parish says in the year in review, from where the hours actually went that year. Each cause has a few lines; the review picks by the week and never repeats last year's. Causes are read from the routine by systems/review.ts.

no_visits: that you are a hard man to find outside Mass
that the sick get the chaplain and the dying get whoever is on
that the door is answered by the secretary, when it is answered
confessions_min: that the box is open when the bulletin says and not a minute longer
that a man with something to say has to catch you in the parking lot
homily_min: that the homily is short, which some of them count a mercy
that Sunday is over by eleven and nobody is quite sure what it was about
recycled: that the homily has come from the file for weeks, and people have begun to say so
that they have heard the one about the seed before, twice
no_groups: that the groups run themselves, and know it
that the parish council has not seen you since the budget
prep_min: that the couples get a pamphlet and a date
that the parents were told to bring the child at ten and that was the preparation
meetings_min: that the staff meet on Tuesdays and you are sometimes there
that the finance council learns what you have decided from the bulletin
full: that they see you, in the hospital and at the door, and that it shows on Sunday
that you are at the school Mass, the wake, and the fish fry, and that people notice who is not
that the parish has a pastor who knows their names, which is the whole of it
around: that you are around, mostly, and that the homilies are yours
that you are there when it matters and elsewhere when it does not, which is fair
absent: that they see you at Mass and nowhere else
that the rectory light is on and the door is shut
